comment: Permanent media lock for Luna-Quest. See docs/design/Luna-Quest_Immutable_Assets_EN.md. Every tracked copy of the intro film and the Cute Astronaut is pinned by SHA-256. Generated copies are checked when present, but are build artefacts and are not required in a fresh clone.

locked.role: Godot .NET copy of the same model
static bake of the same model at the frozen idle pose, not a second model
Godot copy of the same film
poster frame taken from the existing film

rules.intro: The existing film is final. Never re-render, re-encode, trim, replace or regenerate it, and never create another intro video, even if the model, the game, the story or the engine changes. Only playback, skip and decode-failure handling may be edited.
rules.astronaut: The existing Cute Astronaut is the only human character model. Every astronaut must load it. Fixing it is allowed; replacing it, downloading another model or introducing a second astronaut model is not.
rules.credit: Cute Astronaut by haefu, Sketchfab, CC BY 4.0. Model id 816bd786fe8b4559a009de6a95582003. Attribution must stay in CREDITS.md.
rules.unusedSecondSuit: assets/models/lunar_colony/eva-suit-23f03707.glb is a decorative kit prop, not a character. It must never enter any character loading path.
rules.newIntroFiles: No file named intro*.{mp4,webm,ogv,mov,mkv,avi,m4v,mpg} may exist outside this lock file.
rules.newAstronautFiles: No new astronaut, suit or crew mesh file may be added to the repository.
